title: Native Canvas, Camera, Registration & Interaction Surface
start_authority: Owner Continue on 2026-08-29 America/Chicago after re-reading the current ISE-01 checkpoint, ISE program/backlog, ISE roadmap amendment, A5 Scene boundaries, completed AAI/MAI status, application main 28fb49b174095abf4b1093af362c0a1191672091, AIOC main 8eecf5baee5f44a662af2925a0c652b41447e54e and the active-family validation contract.
objective: Deliver the accelerated native Scene canvas with presentation-only camera controls, selection and interaction, keyboard-accessible equivalents, GM/player projection modes, undo/redo and assisted user-correctable image registration while preserving canonical Scene, permission and owner-domain meaning.

canvas_surface.render_authority: Consumes authorized SceneRecord and SceneMapVersion projections only; the canvas does not create a parallel Scene ledger.

registration.purpose: Represent user-correctable image-to-Scene registration proposals without replacing A5 Scene calibration authority.
registration.control_points: Explicit source-image to registered-canvas control points with stable IDs.
registration.assistance: Grid/geometry suggestions carry confidence and remain provisional until user confirmation.
registration.confirmation_rule: No generated registration becomes authoritative merely because confidence is high; the surface emits a confirmed proposal for the owning Scene layer to validate/persist.

permissions_accessibility.projection_rule: Hidden or GM-only state must already be filtered before rendering and must never be revealed by camera, selection, search, counts, diagnostics or keyboard alternatives.
permissions_accessibility.gm_player_modes: Presentation projection modes only; switching view mode cannot mutate canonical permissions.

history.scope: Undo/redo applies only to local ISE-01 presentation/registration draft actions in this tranche.

nonauthorization: token/tactical movement ownership reserved for ISE-02
semantic region triggers reserved for ISE-04
multiplayer golden proof reserved for ISE-08
third-party media redistribution, provider activation, tester distribution, release or deployment

validation_contract.family_transition: Switch ACTIVE_FAMILY_CONTRACT from AAI to ISE, seal completed AAI-01..10 at application baseline 28fb49b174095abf4b1093af362c0a1191672091, and retire prior-family automatic profile authority.
validation_contract.final_gate: Exact candidate head must pass current Repository Health, bounded ISE-01 self-hosted Linux and Windows Validation Core, and deterministic cross-platform comparison before merge.

preserved_boundaries: AAI-01..10 and MAI-01..10 remain completed_verified with no further implementation authority.
Existing Scene, World/Reality, Action/Event, Combat, Character, Creature, Item/Asset, Vehicle and permission authorities remain canonical.
Camera/view/bookmark/selection state is presentation state and cannot redefine canonical Scene meaning.
Generated grid/geometry registration assistance is user-correctable and cannot silently become authoritative.
Hidden and GM-only state must be permission-filtered before projection.
Missing map/audio assets remain nonblocking; placeholders, silence and theater-of-the-mind remain valid.
No third-party media redistribution, paid provider activation, tester distribution, release or deployment is authorized.
next_action: Governed-start transition in progress. Merge the AIOC start authority, create the registered application branch from exact baseline 28fb49b174095abf4b1093af362c0a1191672091, implement the seven bounded deliverables, run only the ISE-01 current-family gate, then close completed_verified and select ISE-02 without starting it.
